snippet.title: [Maimaimaigoen] Game Episode 2, Part 1 (English Subs)
snippet.description:
Translations by Ganbarebenji and Anonymous Piyo ( https://twitter.com/artwaltzed )
Turn on English subtitles by clicking the CC icon at the bottom of the video.

Off to a good(?) start with Episode 2!

The responses you select can increase your friendship with the kids. Check out this video for the dialogue for the other selections: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=2Qsi46I7mdc

The phrase Mamoru uses, " 転ばぬ先の杖 (Korobanu saki no tsue)," means something along the lines of "look before you leap." We decided to leave it as the direct translation, "You need a cane before you fall," since there are some puns and references regarding the "cane" later in this episode.

Thank you for watching, demi!

--

Episode 2 - Promises and Crayons

To safely escape from the mysterious amusement park Uropia, Okada Yu and the children continue to collect medals by taking on various attractions. To ease some of their anxieties, they decide to create a mural by drawing a picture together on a single piece of paper. While searching for the materials they need, they stumble upon a new attraction called "Block Answer."

In this challenge, they get to choose questions from five categories, including Knowledge and Sanrio, to answer. Along the way, they also uncover the past of the Hero Squad and the children participating in the quiz... Can they answer all the questions correctly and earn new medals? Now is the time to put the players' knowledge, memory, and bonds to the test!

--

About Maimaimaigoen

Maimaimaigoen is a multidimensional story about the "growing pains of the heart" of 16 children and their nursery school teachers. It examines each person as an individual and accompanies them through the difficulties of living in today's world.


Introduction

Okada Yu, a new nursery school teacher, is on a field trip to Sanrio Puroland with his students.  As they're about to head home after a fun day, his vision suddenly distorted... They wander into the mysterious amusement park Uropia where they're confronted by a strange yet oddly cute creature called "Froggy Egg." To escape from Uropia, he and the children must challenge the park's attractions and collect 10 medals...

--
